# Nathan Broslawsky

> Executive leadership consulting and organizational systems expertise focused on tech management, team performance, and sustainable engineering practices.

Nathan Broslawsky is a leadership consultant specializing in organizational development, technical leadership, and business transformation. His site combines executive coaching, speaking engagements, and thought leadership on modern management challenges.

## Key Topics

- Leadership Development
- Organizational Systems
- Technical Debt Management
- Team Performance
- Executive Coaching
- Fractional CTO
- Talent Strategy
- Product Management
- Business Transformation
- Tech Management
- Communication Practices
- Career Development
- Engineering Leadership
- Sustainable Practices

## Leadership & Organizational Strategy

- [The Hidden Operating System Running Your Organization](https://www.nathanbroslawsky.com/p/the-hidden-operating-system-running-your-organization): Exploration of career ladders and promotion systems as organizational infrastructure
- [Stop Chasing Updates](https://www.nathanbroslawsky.com/p/stop-chasing-updates): Leadership strategy for building information systems that scale executive management
- [Identity Careers Are Over. Polymer Professions are in.](https://www.nathanbroslawsky.com/p/identity-careers-are-over-polymer-professions-are-in): Exploring adaptive, integrative careers and the future of professional development

## Engineering & Technical Leadership

- [Stop Trying To Protect Your Tech Debt Time](https://www.nathanbroslawsky.com/p/stop-trying-to-protect-your-tech-debt-time): Reframing technical debt as business investment for better engineering decisions
- [Work the Problem, Not the Ticket](https://www.nathanbroslawsky.com/p/work-the-problem-not-the-ticket): Guide to solving root causes instead of treating symptoms in ticket-driven development
- [Before You Build That Admin Tool](https://www.nathanbroslawsky.com/p/before-you-build-that-admin-tool): Analysis of self-service tools as infrastructure investments, not speed solutions

## Team Communication & Collaboration

- ["But Did You Ask?"](https://www.nathanbroslawsky.com/p/but-did-you-ask): Addressing assumption paralysis and improving organizational communication practices
